sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Miracle Worker is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come on over, you're right on time. I've got a little bet going with one of the regular spectators, and you're the subject. He says you should've been taken out ages ago, statistically speaking, you know what I mean? But in my experience, luck and skill can work some pretty serious miracles. This spectator of mine put a lot of money against you and got some of his friends in on it. But I believe in you, so I put down a little bet at some nice odds that you'd beat the statistics. Time to show these mathematicians how things really work in the real world. Don't let me down."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 25 enemies in BlastGang mode
- Win 3 matches in BlastGang mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +20,000 EXP
- 1,000,000 Roubles
- 100 GP coins
- 1× Panacea crate
- 1× Morbus crate
- 2 Battle Points
